description: This file defines the MerchantConfiguration entity class in a Java-based e-commerce system, modeling configuration data associated with merchants, including fields for ID, merchant store association, configuration key/value, and type, with JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: MerchantConfiguration
classes.description: Entity class representing merchant configuration settings, including configuration key, value, type, and associations to merchant store and audit details.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the merchant configuration.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the merchant configuration.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this configuration.

methods.name: getMerchantConfigurationType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of merchant configuration.

methods.name: setMerchantConfigurationType
methods.description: Sets the type of merchant configuration.
